articles.summary: A full-service institutional markets offering, backed by an experienced capital markets team and BitGo's digital asset infrastructure BitGo Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BTGO) (“BitGo” or “Company”), the digital asset infrastructure company, today announced the launch of BitGo Global Markets, its institutional trading and financial solutions business bringing together global liquidity, execution, financing, derivatives, and settlement capabilities. Global Markets combines BitGo’s established institutional trading business and Prime Services offering with expanded derivatives, collateral management, and structured finance expertise. Supported by BitGo’s digital asset infrastructure, the business serves institutions seeking to trade at scale, access capital, and take a more deliberate approach to managing their digital asset exposure.
